newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan seeks 250,000 bbl of reformate for November.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan seeks 250,000 bbl of reformate for November.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has issued a tender to buy one cargo of unleaded reformate for November delivery, an official said on Thursday.
The official said although CPC sought one cargo in the tender, it "does not need the cargo and can drop the requirement if prices rose too much".

The tender for 250,000 barrels of 95-octane unleaded reformate for delivery on a cost-and-freight basis (c-and-f) to Keelung or Taichung between November 1-20, closes September 24 with offers valid for two days.
The official said the partial shutdown of the Taoyuan refinery had not affected its reformate needs.
In its last tender, CPC bought 500,000 barrels of reformate for October 16-30 delivery at close to $24.00 per barrel on a c-and-f basis, much higher than its purchases for September at $22.20-$22.30.
